agent-coordination.purpose: coordination.role_failover / ql_consumer_fencing for launcher.consumer_fencing; the suite fails if this import is unavailable

agent-hub.purpose: trusted Agent Hub host code resolved by launcher.launch.resolve_hub_path (AGENT_HUB_HOST_PATH) for managed-profile argv

host_runtime_skip_allowlist.why: Host-evidence tests prove the installed pinned runtime (ZCode node/CJS, zcodex, OpenCode) on the launcher host. GitHub-hosted runners do not have that proprietary runtime; staging stand-ins there would fabricate evidence. They may skip only in --ci mode and only with the requires_host_runtime reason; --require-host-runtime (the Hetzner run) allows zero skips.
